clauses.english: cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and it became a serpent

clauses.deu: warf seinen Stab vor Pharao, und er ward zur Schlange
clauses.spa: echó su vara delante de Faraón, y se tornó culebra

clauses.english: made a molten calf from the people's golden earrings
clauses.ukr: зробив лите теля із золотих сережок народу
clauses.deu: machte aus den goldenen Ohrenringen des Volkes ein gegossenes Kalb

clauses.why: The verses do not say he stopped the plague by running; he ran, put on incense, made atonement and stood between the dead and the living, and the plague was stayed.
clauses.english: made atonement for the people with incense, and the plague was stayed
clauses.ukr: очистив народ кадилом, і поразка затрималась
clauses.deu: versöhnte das Volk mit Räuchwerk, und der Plage ward gewehrt
clauses.spa: hizo expiación por el pueblo con perfume, y cesó la mortandad

clauses.why: Mount Hor is named in 20:27, just outside the citation; the death is in 20:28.
clauses.spa: murió en el monte de Hor

answer.note: The line omits his making of the altar and the proclamation of a feast to the LORD at the calf, and his role in the priesthood.
